01-hadley-pair.name: Hadley cells
01-hadley-pair.answerNote: In the idealized average, air rises near the equator and sinks in the subtropics.

02-ferrel-pair.name: Ferrel cells
02-ferrel-pair.answerNote: This is an indirect, eddy-driven average, not a closed air-parcel loop.

03-polar-pair.name: Polar cells
03-polar-pair.answerNote: In the idealized average, air sinks over the poles and rises near the polar front.
